design_decision.chosen: Refuse at the MCP tool boundary, not only in PE. Engine emitPdfDossier honesty is P-90.
design_decision.why: A raw tool caller must not mint or re-download a hollow X-ray. Dispatch: if the refuse belongs in the engine assembler, still refuse at MCP so a non-PE caller cannot bypass PE.
design_decision.rejected_alternative: Chip UNAVAILABLE and still write a PDF. That is the costume the adversarial already named.
design_decision.engine_liveViewUrl: Engine dossierRefreshBody (parcel-terrain.ts:102-153) has no liveViewUrl field. Zod strips it. MCP still puts the exact URL on the POST body and on returned metadata. Assembler print is P-90.
